items.title: Review requests for the billing area are concentrated on one reviewer
items.body: PR #501, PR #503, and PR #510 each request review from the same person, and all three are still open. That is a concentration worth naming, whatever the reason for it.

items.title: PROJ-70's remaining in-flight children all sit with one assignee
items.body: Of the three open child issues under epic PROJ-70, all three are assigned to the same person, so a delay on their side delays the whole epic.
